questions.stem: A couple has four children who are all girls. What is the probability that their next child will be a boy?

options.text: 100% because they are due a boy
0% because they can only have girls
50% because each pregnancy is an independent event
25% because they already have four girls

questions.explanation: Each pregnancy is an independent event, so the probability of having a boy is always 50% (1 in 2), regardless of the sex of previous children.
